title: Give Dont Drop
description: Give Dont Drop (GDD) adds a safe item-giving system that lets players hand items directly to others without dropping them, with visual feedback and sounds.
body:
Give – Don’t Drop makes item sharing smarter — and a bit more mischievous.

No more throwing items on the ground. Items are handed over directly, keeping multiplayer clean, safe, and intentional.

But watch your back…
There’s a sneaky way to give items that’s perfect for surprising friends when they least expect it 👀

🤝 Direct item transfers
😈 Friendly prank potential
🛡 No accidental drops
🎭 Multiplayer fun

Use wisely. Or don’t 😉
